lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard it's time to hit the hay,
He dragged a bale in right away!
Kiki laughed, you silly pup,
There's a comfy bed, go hop up!
[chorus]
Hit the hay, hit the hay,
Close your eyes and end the day!
Hit the hay, hit the hay,
Time to sleep and drift away!
[verse]
It means it's time to go to bed,
Fluff your pillow, rest your head,
Long ago, beds were stuffed with hay,
So hit the hay means sleep, hooray!
[chorus]
Hit the hay, hit the hay,
Close your eyes and end the day!
Hit the hay, hit the hay,
Dream until a brand new day!
[outro]
So when the moon is shining bright,
Hit the hay and say goodnight!
